SELECT user_id,passage_id,status,score FROM reading_attempts ORDER BY user_id
SELECT user_id,test_id,status,score FROM listening_attempts ORDER BY user_id
SELECT user_id,mastery,srs_stage,correct_count,incorrect_count,interval_days FROM user_vocabulary ORDER BY user_id
SELECT user_id,kind,points,dedupe_key FROM vocab_point_events ORDER BY kind
SELECT type,payload FROM activity_events WHERE type IN ('VOCAB_REVIEWED','GRAMMAR_PRACTICE_SUBMITTED','CONTENT_DELETED') ORDER BY type,payload::text
SELECT user_id,prompt_id,status,content,word_count FROM writing_submissions ORDER BY user_id
SELECT user_id,part,status,transcript,transcript_origin FROM speaking_attempts ORDER BY user_id
SELECT user_id,status,recall_text,score,evaluator_version FROM retention_attempts ORDER BY user_id
SELECT id,retention_text_id,version_number,body_text,word_count,scoring_structure FROM retention_text_versions ORDER BY id
SELECT source_type,passage_id,surface_form,start_char,end_char,resolution_status,resolution_source FROM lexical_occurrences WHERE source_type='reading' ORDER BY start_char
SELECT retention_text_version_id,start_char,end_char,surface_form,lexeme_id FROM lexical_occurrences WHERE source_type='retention' ORDER BY retention_text_version_id,start_char
SELECT action,target_id,metadata FROM audit_log WHERE action='retention_text.version_created' ORDER BY target_id

SELECT module,content_type,source_ref,version_no,status,change_kind,publication_state,title,track,CASE WHEN module='reading' THEN NULL ELSE content_hash END AS content_hash,semantic_hash,answer_key_hash,content_snapshot,provenance FROM content_versions WHERE source_ref LIKE 'parity-author-%' ORDER BY source_ref,version_no
SELECT source_ref,title,audio_type,audio_url,transcript,difficulty_level,publication_state FROM listening_tests WHERE source_ref LIKE 'parity-author-%' ORDER BY source_ref

SELECT t.source_ref,q."order",q.type,q.type_code,q.question_text,q.options,q.correct_answer,q.explanation,q.keywords,q.paraphrases FROM listening_tests t JOIN listening_questions q ON q.test_id=t.id WHERE t.source_ref LIKE 'parity-author-%' ORDER BY t.source_ref,q."order"
SELECT source_ref,passage_no,title,body_text,publication_state FROM reading_passages WHERE source_ref LIKE 'parity-author-%' ORDER BY source_ref,publication_state
SELECT source_ref,task_type,category,prompt,target_word_count,publication_state FROM writing_prompts WHERE source_ref LIKE 'parity-author-%' ORDER BY source_ref
SELECT source_ref,title,category,body,summary,duration_minutes,publication_state FROM writing_lessons WHERE source_ref LIKE 'parity-author-%' ORDER BY source_ref
SELECT source_ref,title,task_type,topic,target_band,body,word_count,provenance,publication_state FROM writing_model_texts WHERE source_ref LIKE 'parity-author-%' ORDER BY source_ref

SELECT v.source_ref,p.pattern,p.function,p.task_type,p.topic,p.target_band,p.example,p.provenance,p.publication_state FROM content_versions v JOIN writing_language_patterns p ON p.id=v.target_id WHERE v.source_ref LIKE 'parity-author-%' AND v.content_type='pattern' ORDER BY v.source_ref

SELECT t.source_ref,s.position,s.uzbek_source,s.model_english,s.accepted_alternatives,s.notes,s.target_lexical_items FROM writing_translation_sets t JOIN writing_translation_sentences s ON s.set_id=t.id WHERE t.source_ref LIKE 'parity-author-%' ORDER BY t.source_ref,s.position

SELECT external_id,part,category,prompt_text,cue_card,prep_seconds,answer_seconds,follow_ups,topic,publication_state FROM speaking_prompts WHERE external_id LIKE 'parity-author-%' ORDER BY external_id

SELECT v.source_ref,s.title,s.category,s.primary_type,s.primary_url,s.publication_state FROM content_versions v JOIN speaking_materials s ON s.id=v.target_id WHERE v.source_ref LIKE 'parity-author-%' ORDER BY v.source_ref

SELECT t.source_ref,t.title,t.skill_area,t.explanation,t.publication_state,e."order",e.prompt_text,e.options,e.correct_option,e.explanation FROM grammar_topics t JOIN grammar_exercises e ON e.topic_id=t.id WHERE t.source_ref LIKE 'parity-author-%' ORDER BY t.source_ref,e."order"

SELECT p.source_ref,p.slug,p.label_en,p.label_uz,p.position,p.publication_state,m.position,l.term,l.part_of_speech,l.definition_en,l.sense_key FROM vocabulary_topic_packs p JOIN vocabulary_topic_pack_words m ON m.pack_id=p.id JOIN lexemes l ON l.id=m.lexeme_id WHERE p.source_ref LIKE 'parity-author-%' ORDER BY p.source_ref,m.position

SELECT l.source_ref,l.title,l.slug,l.summary,l.learning_area,l.teacher_notes,l.estimated_minutes,l.publication_state,b.position,b.type,b.text_content FROM lessons l JOIN lesson_blocks b ON b.lesson_id=l.id WHERE l.source_ref LIKE 'parity-author-%' ORDER BY l.source_ref,b.position
